tools.name: repo_read
tools.purpose: List, read and search the configured GitHub repository.
tools.access: Agent must have repo_access read or write.

tools.name: repo_write
tools.purpose: Create an agent branch, commit an allowlisted file batch and open a pull request.
tools.access: Runner adds this when the run receives allowWrite=true or the agent record has repo_access=write. The authority policy requires task-scoped grants; persisted write entitlements must be treated as high risk and explicitly approved.

refused_paths.name: delegate_to_agent
refused_paths.purpose: Delegate one bounded task to a named teammate with its own prompt, budget and step limit.
refused_paths.access: Runner adds this tool when the agent record has can_delegate=true; the team charter reserves dispatch responsibility to HERMES.

refused_paths.name: read_artifact
refused_paths.purpose: Read an addressable teammate artifact by artifact ID and offset.
refused_paths.access: Available to agents for handoff continuity.

refused_paths.name: http_fetch
refused_paths.purpose: Fetch public HTTP(S) resources; paid x402 requests are separately gated when enabled.
refused_paths.access: Added only when the agent record has x402_enabled=true; network destination is guarded.
guards: x402 seller allowlist defaults to deny
per-call cap is the minimum of agent, caller and platform cap

refused_paths.name: namespaced_mcp_tools
refused_paths.purpose: Expose tools discovered from explicitly configured remote MCP servers as mcp_<server>_<tool>.
refused_paths.access: Only from the agent's configured MCP server list.
guards: URL revalidation before each tool call

tools.policy_note: This manifest describes the current in-product runtime. Host-specific IDE tools are separate and cannot grant or bypass these server-side controls.
